description: Show or hide the core and cavity colours on the active part, in the part local frame. on true classifies every face from the mold-analysis pull by complete visibility (core along +pull, cavity along -pull). A wall within 0.5° of vertical is still core or cavity: it takes the role of the labelled neighbour it can reach, so an inner pocket wall joins the core and an outer wall joins the cavity. There is no separate zero-draft colour. The outer parting loop is a polyline. Stamped faces keep their edge names on that loop. on false removes the skin so face paint and the part colour show again. Omit on to toggle. Read-only. Not a CAD draft edit and not a quote.

on.description: true shows core and cavity colours and the outer parting line. false restores paint and the part colour. Omit to toggle.

name: mold_parting
